intro.sr: Administrator pronalazi korisnika po emailu u „Korisnici“ i pregleda role i dozvole u „Role“.
intro.en: An administrator finds a user by email in “Korisnici” and looks at the roles and permissions in “Role”.

admin-korisnici-pretraga.sr: Korisnika nalazimo po emailu ili imenu.
admin-korisnici-pretraga.en: We find the user by email or name.

korisnik-detalji.sr: Vide se podaci naloga, uloga i aktivnost. Odavde se nalog može i deaktivirati.
korisnik-detalji.en: The account data, role and activity are visible. From here an account can also be deactivated.

role-pregled.sr: Uloga određuje šta ko sme da radi: administrator, zaposleni, partner i korisnik imaju različite dozvole.
role-pregled.en: A role decides what each person may do: administrator, employee, partner and user have different permissions.
